disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; participants with autism including those with mild intellectual disability, recruited across 6 sites from the EU-AIMS LEAP cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We included 206 neurotypical (NT) (79 female, aged 17.5 ± 6.1 years) and 316 participants with autism (88 female, aged 17.2 ± 5.7) including mild intellectual disability participants across 6 sites from the EU-AIMS LEAP sample."

dataset-of-origin.detail: EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP); 6 sites (Cambridge, KCL, Mannheim, Nijmegen, Rome, Utrecht).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "316 participants with autism (88 female, aged 17.2 ± 5.7) including mild intellectual disability participants across 6 sites from the EU-AIMS LEAP sample"

age.detail: Age of the ASD clinical cohort (N=316). Range 6–31 years stated in the abstract; mean ± SD from Methods.
age.supporting_text: "316 participants with autism (88 female, age mean: 17.2 ± 5.7)...aged 6-31 years across six sites"

sex.detail: Female N=88 reported directly. Male N estimated as 316−88=228. Percentages calculated from counts (88/316=27.8%, 228/316=72.2%).
